title: ComputationAddSpec
description: INPUT of `dmtool -m <model> computation add <spec.json>` and `computation modify <path> --spec <spec.json>` — A12's computation shape. Add persists it; modify is a whole re-expression, so an omitted optional property is removed. Both routes are kernel-gated before writing.

computedField.description: the calculated field's ABSOLUTE path; the computation is placed in its parent group (its iteration scope). A computation that reads per-row fields must compute a field INSIDE that repeatable group; to compute a non-repeatable field from per-row data, aggregate first (e.g. Sum(Group*/Field)) — else MVK_ERROR_FIELD_NOT_IN_RULEGROUP.

commonPrecondition.description: optional guard (A12 DSL) shared by all alternatives

comment.description: optional explanatory note, persisted as a leading ;; comment on the first operation

alternatives.description: ≥1 (precondition?, operation, toleranceRangeOp?) tier — either one unconditional {operation} or all preconditioned {precondition, operation} (the kernel rejects mixing). Computation takes the first holding tier, but implicit validation retains every holding tier's mismatch, so preconditions must be mutually exclusive

precondition.description: the tier's guard in A12 DSL (omit for the single unconditional alternative)

operation.description: the value-expression in A12 DSL, assigned to the computed field when the precondition holds. It may not read the computed field itself — plainly (MVK_ERROR_REFERENCE_TO_CALCULATED_FIELD) or through an enum category / semantic index (MVK_ERROR_SEMANTIC_INDEX_OR_CATEGORY_FOR_ERRORFIELD, which pre-empts the plain code); the same ban covers precondition. A derived-scale mismatch against the target is reported BEFORE either, so such an operation is a two-repair rejection

toleranceRangeOp.description: optional closed tolerance band for this alternative's implicit validation; a stored computed value fires the computation's validation only when its absolute difference from the operation exceeds the selected band

errorCodesToSuppress.description: A12 IComputation.errorCodesToSuppress, serialized unchanged as an array. The kernel currently accepts only MVK_INVALID_COMPARE_DEC_PLACES; use it when a numeric operation is intentionally valid despite the static assignment-scale gate. Omit (or pass []) for no suppression.

messages.description: ≥1 localized self-validation message; cover every locale the model declares

locale.description: a full locale code, e.g. en_US (bare 'en' is rejected by the kernel)

text.description: the self-validation message text; may use the same kernel interpolation tokens as rule messages

examples.comment: one-third of the base fee is intentional

messages.text: Effective fee is one-third of base.
Effektivgebühr ist ein Drittel der Basis.
